_comment: Card catalog for one-tap card registration in the Assistant. Researched 16 Oct 2026 from issuer-owned pages and issuer fee/terms PDFs only (no blogs, no comparison sites, nothing from memory). Every fee, ATM rule and benefit comes from the linked official source on its 'checked' date and may change after that. fees: percent is the issuer's stated rate; upTo=true means 'not more than'; a 0 entry means the issuer explicitly states no such fee; an empty list means the issuer states no figure. faceColor is sampled from the issuer's own card picture and is drawn as a plain coloured card (no logos); printedText lists only the words readable on the front of that picture (empty when none are readable). Cards researched but left out (no official network, no official fee figure, or conflicting documents): Capital One Venture, Discover it, ttb all free, Krungsri Boarding Card, Bangkok Bank Be1st.
